_comment: Pinned inputs for the data build. Bump a commit on purpose, re-run fetch_sources.py, update the sha256 values, rebuild. Downloaded files land in data/sources/ (gitignored). TBESH asks not to be redistributed, so only derived glosses are published, with attribution.

oshb.name: Open Scriptures Hebrew Bible (Westminster Leningrad Codex with morphology)
oshb.licence: Lemma and morphology CC BY 4.0; WLC text public domain

hebrewlexicon.name: OpenScriptures Hebrew Lexicon (Lexical Index, Brown-Driver-Briggs)
hebrewlexicon.licence: CC BY 4.0; BDB and Strong's text public domain

tbesh.name: TBESH, Translators Brief lexicon of Extended Strongs for Hebrew (glosses only)
tbesh.licence: CC BY 4.0 (STEPBible.org, Tyndale House Cambridge). The Meaning column is Online Bible material and is NOT used.
tbesh.credit: STEPBible.org, based on work at Tyndale House Cambridge
